podcast.body: This particular track is an unconditional staple in all Chemical Brothers' tours and appears across their discography, sometimes as a full song, sometimes as a sampled element. Ed Simons, known as "the inexpressive active member" of The Chemical Brothers, has consistently identified it as one of the best pieces they have ever created and states he is still not tired of it today. Despite the band's affection for the song and its universal acclaim, Virgin Records initially harbored significant doubts about its commercial viability as a single. It was eventually released as a fourth single approximately 1.5 years after the "Surrender" album had been on the market, prompted by the continued strong performance of the three earlier singles. "El mío sí Respons es una pieza que para los que ya he sido a conciertos de los Chemical Prodex suena incondicionalmente en todas sus giras, en todos sus discos, a veces suena cocacción, a veces suena cocosampleado y que incluso éximos más conocido como el activo inexpresivo de los Chemical Prodex siempre había definido como una de las mejores piezas que ha hecho y que hoy en día no se ha casado de ella."
